digest.component_or_area: CI gate: Git version floor step (.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml)
propositions: The Git version floor gate step reads .github/git-version-floor.txt from the checked-out patchset tree and fails hard (exit 1) when the file is absent.
Gerrit's Verified lane runs the workflow definition from main but checks out the change's tree, causing any pre-merge change to fail the gate despite never modifying version-related code.
The gate violates the documented ee2a pattern which mandates that new gate steps must skip (with a log line) when their data files are absent from the checked-out tree.
A change branched before the gate merged fails CI with the gate but without the corresponding floor file present, false-negating Verified on unrelated changes.
The fix applies the established if-present guard: skip with explanatory logging when the floor file is absent; when present, enforce version requirements unchanged.
